title: "Building Cascade"
description: "Build the Cascade binary and image, and choose the database Cascade runs on."
editUrl: false
---

You need Go and Podman. `make build` builds the Cascade binary, and `make image` builds the container image with Podman, with the editor built into the binary so there is nothing to install beside it.

The database is a setting. `HOTLOOP_CASCADE_DATABASE` is `sqlite:<path>` (the default, under `HOTLOOP_CASCADE_DATA_DIR`) or a `postgres://` URL.

No Docker and no Compose. Cascade ships for Podman (with Quadlet) and for k3s (with Helm).
